description: This file defines the Configuration class within the SuiteCRM\Utility namespace, which implements ArrayAccess to manage configuration settings loaded from the Configurator component. It includes methods to get, set, check existence, and unset configuration options and relies on external Configurator class.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Class providing an array-like interface to configuration settings loaded from the SuiteCRM Configurator.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Configuration object by requiring the Configurator class and loading its config property into the container.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets a configuration value for a given offset, throws exception if offset is null or not existing.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if a configuration offset exists in the container.

methods.name: offsetUnset
methods.description: Removes a configuration offset from the container.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given configuration offset, or null if not set.
